verdict.rationale: The product's public GitHub repository (Kong/insomnia) has an Apache License 2.0 LICENSE file, and the README's License section points to it, so users can read the source under an OSI-approved open license. A 2016 community comment calling it "not open source" predates the current repository and is not a concrete contradiction of today's license. Missing for 10: recent independent corroboration that the full current product source (including cloud/AI features) is covered by the open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: the README's License section states: [Apache-2.0](LICENSE) (c) Insomnia (insomnia.rest).
